info.title: Tic-tac-toe PvP API
info.description: External HTTPS API. TLS terminates at Istio ingress; internal calls use HTTP. WebSocket is a separate exact /wss endpoint. Installs of schema validators are deferred by user instruction.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable commandId. Same key and changed payload is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
parameters.description: Required for WEB clientType; obtained from /auth/csrf and bound to the pre-auth cookie. Not required for NATIVE.

parameters.name: X-Client-Type
parameters.description: Native pre-login requests without bearer send NATIVE and omit Origin/cookies. Browser Origin or session cookie always requires CSRF regardless of this header.
